  • Potent Cantrip

    Enemies succeeding a saving throw against a cantrip still take half the damage.

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

Technical

Stats

Githyanki_IntelligenceOfficer
Githyanki ardents are a class-like archetype of githyanki NPC encountered in Crèche Y'llek. Mages that specialize in psionic combat, ardents are the purest githyanki spellcasters encountered in the game.

Combat

Attacks and actions

Ardents wield a  Githyanki Shortsword, though they will always prefer casting a cantrip over swinging their sword, unless forced by silence. Despite this reluctance for swordsmanship, they also benefit from an extra attack.

 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Githyanki Shortsword
Damage: 3~8
1d6 + 2⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Psychic Rend ()
Damage: 2~16 + modifiers
2d8 + Spellcasting modifier⁠Psychic
Reach into an enemy's mind. Tear it to pieces and inflict Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Saving Throws.
 INT Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Mirror Image ( + )

Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your  Armour Class by 3.

Whenever you successfully evade an attack, one of the duplicates disappears.

 Range: Self
 Misty Step ()

Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Recharge: Long rest
 Sleep ( + )

Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
